schema.title: Response Runs Projects  Project Id  Runs Get
Response Candidates Runs  Run Id  Candidates Get
Response Compare Runs Metrics Compare Get
Response Project Metrics Metrics Project  Project Id  Get

AddParam.title: AddParam
AddParam.description: Add a query parameter absent from the source request.

AppendToParam.title: AppendToParam
AppendToParam.description: Append to a string query param (joined by ``separator``) or to a list param.

CriterionScore.title: CriterionScore
CriterionScore.description: Result of one filter criterion (rules + optional LLM check).

duplicate_of.title: Duplicate Of
duplicate_of.description: Candidate id this MR is redundant with.

path.title: Path
path.description: Target endpoint. Omit to reuse the source path.

FollowupSpec.title: FollowupSpec
FollowupSpec.description: A follow-up request derived from the source request.

HttpMethod.title: HttpMethod
HttpMethod.description: Only safe methods: the executor never mutates the system under test.

InputVariant.title: InputVariant
InputVariant.description: Extra input instance: overrides merged on top of the source request params.

requests_per_minute.title: Requests Per Minute
requests_per_minute.description: Client-side limit per model; None = no limit.

spec.description: None only when the LLM output was not executable.

raw_output.title: Raw Output
raw_output.description: Original LLM item, kept when spec is None.

MRCandidate.title: MRCandidate
MRCandidate.description: An MR plus everything the pipeline and the reviewer attached to it.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Which fault this MR could reveal and why.

MRSpec.title: MRSpec
MRSpec.description: An executable metamorphic relation, as produced by the LLM.

PipelineSettings.title: PipelineSettings
PipelineSettings.description: Snapshot of the configuration used by a run (store it with the run).

source_selector.title: Source Selector
source_selector.description: JSONPath applied to the source response body, e.g. $.results[*].id

followup_selector.title: Followup Selector
followup_selector.description: JSONPath applied to each follow-up response. Defaults to source_selector.

direction.description: Required for subset and count_leq only.

RelationType.title: RelationType
RelationType.description:
Closed catalog. Semantics (S = source selection, Fi = follow-up i selection)
are documented in docs/MR_SCHEMA.md and implemented by the executor.

RemoveParam.title: RemoveParam
RemoveParam.description: Remove a query parameter present in the source request.

path.title: Path
path.description: OpenAPI path template, e.g. /items/{id}. Must exist in the spec.

path_params.title: Path Params
path_params.description: Value for every {placeholder} in path, and nothing else.

RequestSpec.title: RequestSpec
RequestSpec.description: A concrete request against the API under test (base URL excluded).

round_to_int.title: Round To Int
round_to_int.description: If the original value is an int, round the result to int.

ScaleParam.title: ScaleParam
ScaleParam.description: Multiply a numeric parameter by ``factor`` (e.g. halve a page size).

max_similarity.title: Max Similarity
max_similarity.description: Highest cosine similarity to an already selected MR.

SetParam.title: SetParam
SetParam.description: Set (or overwrite) a parameter of the follow-up request.
